text:
Priya K: FYI — inbound from Acadia (fintech). They want a multi-region reserved + burst plan with a single blended per-token rate across us-east/us-west/eu.
Alex M: Hmm — do they want true unified billing or just a quoted blended rate for the commit? Differences matter for routing & SLOs.
Tom Sales: They asked for unified billing. Key asks: predictable monthly cost, burst headroom, and clear overage credits if we spike. Also needs EU data residency for some traffic.
Lisa Support: Also flagged: they will run both low-latency chat and high-throughput embedding pipelines. Different token profiles per workload.
Marco P: Important: batching/quantization recommendations will affect unit cost. If we guarantee a blended rate, we need rules for model class + quantization applied.
Priya K: Proposed product input needed: 1) recommended pricing formula, 2) launch acceptance criteria (SLOs + rollout steps), 3) edge cases for overages & multi-region routing.
Tom Sales: Sales asks for a simple proposal to present next week. Can we give a sample term: 12mo reserved 100M tokens, blended rate, 20% burst pool, overage credits for sustained spikes?
Alex M: Draft idea:
```
reserved_commit: 100_000_000 tokens/mo
blended_rate: $0.00095/token
burst_pool: 20% of commit (pay-as-you-go at $0.0012/token)
overage_credit: if monthly usage > 120% of commit for 2 consecutive months => credit 10% of overage cost
regions: commit covers routing across us-east/us-west/eu; EU residency for EU-tagged requests
```
Marco P: That overage credit rule seems reasonable but we need guardrails: limit to 6 months of credits per year and require model/quantization profile review before granting.
Lisa Support: Operational checklist: additional logs for per-region token counts, trace IDs for routed requests, and testing plan for failover (us-west -> us-east fallback).
Finance Bot: Quick calc: blended_rate*commit = $95,000/mo revenue at $0.00095 for 100M. Burst pricing at $0.0012 only kicks in on burst usage.
Priya K: Launch criteria proposal:
- Tech validation: latency SLOs met in each region under 80% commit load
- Billing: unified billing test with sample invoices
- Security: EU residency and KMS verification
- Sales/legal: negotiated SLA + term signed
Tom Sales: Can product draft the short PRD + acceptance checklist by EOD Thursday? I’ll prep the customer pitch.
Alex M: I'll sketch the routing & pricing caveats. Marco, can you write the quantization/optimization prerequisites we require before we finalize the blended rate?
Marco P: Will do. Also note: require a 2-week canary where we monitor token mix and latency before moving from canary -> GA.
Priya K: Perfect. If everyone is aligned I’ll bundle into a triage ticket and link to the sales opportunity.
Tom Sales: :thumbsup: thanks team — urgent but doable.
